jobs.occupation: Tax Manager - Copenhagen
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the tax function of an international shipping company?

Clipper is enhancing its internal tax capability as part of a continued focus on strengthening governance and decision support across the organisation. We are therefore looking for a dedicated and hands-on Tax Manager to be based at Clipper’s headquarters in Copenhagen.

Today, tax matters at Clipper are handled across Finance, Legal and external advisors. With increasing regulatory complexity and risk exposure, we are establishing a more formalized and proactive tax function. The Tax Manager will play a key role in building this capability and embedding robust tax governance across the organization.

You will report directly to the CFO and work closely with the Head of Legal & Corporate Affairs and Head of Controlling and external advisors.

What will be your responsibilities

You will be responsible for both strategic and operational tax matters across Clipper’s global activities. Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to:

• Establish and maintain Clipper’s tax governance framework, including a tax risk register and clear processes for identifying, assessing and managing tax risks.

• Review the tax implications of material transactions and challenge tax positions and advice from external advisors where relevant.

• Own and oversee transfer pricing policies, intercompany agreements, benchmarking and documentation.

• Monitor and manage cross-border tax matters, including withholding tax, freight tax and permanent establishment risks.

• Oversee compliance with Danish tonnage tax requirements, including calculations, documentation and relevant controls.

• Coordinate corporate tax, VAT and employment tax compliance and reporting across jurisdictions, ensuring timely filings and robust documentation.

• Advise on tax matters related to international employee mobility and contractor arrangements.

• Monitor relevant tax and regulatory developments, including OECD Pillar Two and environmental and emissions-related taxes, and assess their impact on Clipper.

• Act as Clipper’s internal tax expert and trusted sparring partner, advising management on tax implications of strategic and operational decisions.

What we are looking for

At Clipper, our employees shape our work environment, so bringing a positive attitude is essential.

• We imagine that you have a relevant educational background within finance, tax, business administration, law or similar, combined with solid experience in corporate and international tax.

• You have hands-on experience with tax governance and tax risk management, combined with strong knowledge of transfer pricing, cross-border taxation and international tax principles.

• You are comfortable working with external advisors while also challenging and validating tax positions when needed.

• You are structured and analytical, but also pragmatic and commercially minded.

• You enjoy taking ownership, working independently and turning complex tax matters into practical advice and solutions for the business.

• You communicate confidently across functions and levels of the organisation and are fluent in both Danish and English.

• Shipping experience, including knowledge of tonnage tax or other shipping-specific tax matters, is an advantage, but not a requirement.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

If you’re enthusiastic about this role but your experience doesn’t align perfectly with each qualification, we still encourage you to apply. You could be the ideal candidate for this position, or for another opportunity with us.

What you will love about us

At Clipper, you will become part of a growing and professional work environment where we strive to be the best. We offer:

• A key role with significant influence on Clipper Bulk's tax framework and risk profile

• The opportunity to build and shape an internal tax function

• Close collaboration with senior management and exposure to strategic decision-making

• A welcoming and inclusive work environment with a variety of socal, sports, and cultural events throughout the year

• Attractive employee benefits, including pension, health, dental and critical ilness insurance

• Beautiful office facilities in Nordhavn, located near the metro with on-site paring, delicious lunch arangement and access to fitness facilities and a personal trainer.

Application and recruitment process

Please submit your CV and cover letter through our application portal by 22nd November 2026.

Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis and interviews will be treated with full discretion.

The recruitment process consist of two interview rounds. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a first interview, while candidates progressing to the second round will be asked to complete a personality assessment beforehand. Confidential reference checks will be conducted for final candidates.

Learn more about Clipper at clipper-bulk.com, LinkedIn, and Instagram.

Clipper is an industry leader in dry bulk, an operator, a pool manager, and a specialist in steel services. We operate a modern fleet of approximately 120 handysize and supramax vessels, transporting a wide range of cargo from dry bulk to break bulk. Clipper is commercially headquartered in Copenhagen and employs a staff of around 100 onshore worldwide. We are a global workplace with firm values, where we welcome a growth mindset, curiosity, and ambition.

Sustainability initiatives - we strive to make a positive impact. As a maritime player with a global presence at sea and onshore, we recognize our social, environmental, and ethical responsibility. We push for positive development by responsibly running our business and promoting sustainable business behavior in our network. Read more about sustainability initiatives on our website.

jobs.occupation: CMF Industrial Designer - Crafting Meaning Through Colour, Material & Finish
jobs.description:
Shape how products look, feel, and connect with people.

Do you see colour, material, and finish as more than aesthetics, but as a way to create meaning, trust, and emotional connection? At Coloplast, we design products for people living with deeply personal medical conditions. As part of our Product Development team, you will help define how our products are perceived, experienced, and trusted in everyday use.

Our products are used daily by millions of people. This requires a thoughtful balance between brand expression, user needs, and manufacturing reality ensuring every CMF decision is both meaningful and feasible.

Your Role

As a CMF Designer, you will work across cross-functional teams from early concept through to production, typically across one to two projects at a time. You will translate user insights, brand principles, and product requirements into cohesive CMF directions, balancing aesthetics, usability, and manufacturability. Working closely with industrial designers, engineers, and suppliers, you will ensure CMF intent is realized with quality and consistency.

You will contribute to defining CMF frameworks, palettes, and material strategies, while collaborating across disciplines to ensure alignment and a coherent product expression. At times, you will actively manage stakeholders to align on vision and design direction, ensuring CMF decisions support both design intent and broader product objectives.

You will be surrounded by passionate colleagues who continuously refine and evolve our design language, grounded in our mission to create products that restore dignity and empower users.

Key Responsibilities

•   Develop CMF concepts from early exploration through to production

•   Translate insights and briefs into actionable CMF directions

•   Define colors, materials, and finishes aligned with brand and product intent

•   Support creation of CMF boards, renderings, and physical samples

•   Specify CMF for production (colour targets, finish callouts, durability requirements)

•   Collaborate with engineering and suppliers to ensure feasibility and quality

•   Support communication of CMF intent across teams and stakeholders

•   Support material selection with consideration for cost, performance, and sustainability

•   Research materials, finishes, and processes to identify new opportunities

•   Contribute to innovation in sustainable and high-quality CMF solutions

Experience

•   3-5 years of experience in CMF, Industrial Design, or related fields

•   Degree in Industrial Design, CMF, Textile Design, or similar

•   Portfolio demonstrating strong CMF thinking and product applications

•   Strong understanding of colour theory, various materials, and finishes

•   Experience with manufacturing processes (e.g., injection moulding, coatings, printing)

•   Ability to create CMF specifications for production

•   Proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite and visualization tools (e.g., KeyShot, Vizcom)

•   Fluency in English

Mindset

•   Strong aesthetic sensitivity and attention to detail

•   Ability to translate trends and insights into clear design directions

•   Confident communicator with the ability to explain design rationale

•   Collaborative, curious, and quality-driven

•   Passionate about user-centered design and meaningful product experiences

Why Join Us

At Coloplast, CMF is not just about appearance, it’s about trust, comfort, and dignity. You will help shape products that people rely on every day, in a collaborative and purpose-driven environment.

Interested?

If your qualifications match the description and you’re ready to take your career to the next level, we’d love to hear from you.

Please submit your application, including a link to your portfolio.

If you wish to forward your portfolio as a file instead of providing a link, please contact Ignacio D'Avola at dkigda@coloplast.com.

Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.

We will take candidates into the recruitment process continuously, so do not hesitate to apply. This position will remain open until a suitable candidate has been found.

Pursuing an ambitious growth agenda, Coloplast develops and markets products and services that make life easier for people with intimate healthcare needs. Employing about 16.000 people and with products available in more than 143 countries, we are one of the world´s leading medical device companies. We are constantly growing our business and always looking for new ways to move forward – we explore, learn and look for new ways of doing things.

Coloplast is committed to being an inclusive organization, where people bring their differences to work each day, fulfil their potential and have a strong sense of belonging because – and not despite – of their differences. We therefore encourage all qualified candidates to apply regardless of gender, age, race, nationality, ethnicity, sexual orientation, religious belief or physical ability.

Visit us on Coloplast.com.

Watch the film. Follow us on LinkedIn.

jobs.occupation: Development Manager
jobs.description:
IST is looking for an experienced Development Manager who thrives at the intersection of technology, people, and delivery and who is ready to lead and evolve our development organization to the next level.

At IST, we’re not just building software—we’re shaping the future of education. Our digital tools connect schools, teachers, students, and families in smarter, more meaningful ways. With over five million users across Europe, our mission is clear: to make learning easier, more engaging, and more impactful for everyone.

Joining IST means working in an international, collaborative environment where your leadership and ideas make a real difference. You’ll guide and inspire development teams, influence technical direction, and contribute to products used by thousands of schools—while growing alongside experienced colleagues who are passionate about improving education.

Role overview

We are looking for a Development Manager who is passionate about people, software development and building high-performing engineering teams. In this role, you will lead and support a few development teams while working closely with Product Owners, Architects and other stakeholders to create high-quality software solutions.

As a Development Manager, your primary focus will be leadership, team development, delivery and creating an environment where engineers can thrive and do their best work. We also believe you are curious about emerging technologies and interested in how AI can support software development, collaboration and innovation.

Key responsibilities

• Lead, coach and support some development teams

• Foster a collaborative, inclusive and high-performing engineering culture

• Support team members in their professional growth and development

• Ensure effective ways of working, agile processes and continuous improvement

• Collaborate with Product Owners and other stakeholders to align priorities and deliveries

• Drive recruitment, onboarding and team development activities

• Help teams remove obstacles and improve delivery capabilities

• Follow up on team goals, performance, engagement and work environment

• Encourage experimentation and learning around new technologies, including AI-driven tools and workflows

Role qualifications

We believe you have the following experience, capabilities and personal skills to succeed in this role:

• A bachelor's degree in computer science, software engineering or related field

• Previous experience in a leadership role within software development

• A background in software engineering or technical product development

• Strong communication and collaboration skills

• Experience working with agile development methodologies

• The ability to balance people management with business and delivery needs

• A coaching and supportive leadership style

• An interest in AI and how new technologies can improve the way teams work and deliver software

• Fluent English communication skills, both written and spoken

What we offer

This is a full-time, permanent position. At IST, we apply an office-first policy, meaning we primarily work from the office as we believe physical presence fosters collaboration, innovation, and a strong team spirit. At the same time, we understand the importance of flexibility—if you live farther away, working from the office three days a week with the remaining time remote may be possible. In Scandinavia our offices are located in Stockholm, Växjö, Roskilde and Oslo.

Interested in this role?

Apply Now

By applying, you agree to our privacy policy.

jobs.occupation: PhD Stipend in Experimental Quantum Materials Physics
jobs.description:
Join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production at Aalborg University and contribute to research on the quantum properties of matter at the scale of individual atoms and molecules. This is a full-time, fixed-term PhD stipend for three years, commencing on 1 January 2027 or soon hereafter

**Your work tasks

**The Department of Materials and Production is looking for a PhD candidate in experimental physics to investigate how molecular complexes can be used to engineer quantum properties in materials. The project addresses fundamental questions in quantum science while contributing knowledge that may support future applications within electronics, sensing and energy harvesting. You will become part of the Physics Group and work in an international research collaboration funded by Independent Research Fund Denmark.

Your research will focus on preparing and investigating molecular complexes on crystalline surfaces. You will deposit molecular complexes by electrospray techniques under ultra-high-vacuum conditions and study their structural and electronic properties using low-temperature scanning tunnelling microscopy and scanning tunnelling spectroscopy. The work will involve planning and conducting experiments, documenting methods and results, analysing and discussing data, and communicating findings clearly within the research collaboration and through relevant scientific channels. You will carry out a substantial part of the research independently while collaborating closely with researchers in the project.

Your competencies You hold a master's degree in physics, nanoscience or a closely related field. You have a solid experimental background within physics, surface science or nanoscience, together with documented experience in scanning tunnelling microscopy and spectroscopy, ultra-high-vacuum techniques, cryogenic systems, surface science and electrospray deposition.

You can organise and conduct experimental research in a systematic manner, from the planning of measurements to the documentation, analysis and interpretation of results. You communicate methods and findings clearly in English, both in writing and in dialogue with other researchers. The position calls for a researcher who can take responsibility for their own work while contributing constructively to a collaborative and international research environment.

**Qualification requirements

**PhD stipends are allocated to individuals who hold a Master's degree. PhD stipends are normally for a period of 3 years. It is a prerequisite for allocation of the stipend that the candidate will be enrolled as a PhD student at the Doctoral School of Engineering and Science in accordance with the regulations of Ministerial Order No. 1124 of September 19, 2025 on the PhD Programme at the Universities and Certain Higher Artistic Educational Institutions. According to the Ministerial Order, the progress of the PhD student shall be assessed at regular points in time. As part of the PhD study, you are among other things required to complete PhD courses corresponding to 30 ECTS, gain experience with teaching or other forms of knowledge dissemination and complete an external research stay outside of Aalborg University, preferably 3-6 months at a foreign research institution.

Who we are

You will join the Physics Group at the Department of Materials and Production, where research activities explore materials and physical phenomena relevant to both fundamental science and future technologies. In this position, you will work at the intersection of molecular science, surface science and quantum materials research, with access to a research environment in which experimental methods and scientific discussion form the basis for developing new knowledge.

As part of an international collaboration, you will have the opportunity to engage with researchers across disciplines and contribute to a research project with both scientific depth and technological relevance. The position offers a strong foundation for further work in academic research, advanced experimental physics or research-intensive development environments.

**How to apply

**Your application must include the following:

• Application, stating reasons for applying and qualifications in relation to the position

• Curriculum Vitae (CV)

• Diplomas (bachelor's and master's degree diploma, including grades)

• Other relevant documents

The application must be submitted via Aalborg University’s recruitment system, which can be accessed under the job advertisement on Aalborg University's website.

Aalborg University wants to reflect the surrounding society and has diversity as a core value. Therefore, everyone, regardless of personal background and orientation, is encouraged to apply for the position.

Do you have any questions? If you have any questions about the position, you are more than welcome to contact us. You will find contact persons at the bottom of the jobpost.

Further information Read more about our recruitment process here.

The assessment of candidates for the position will be carried out by qualified experts.

Shortlisting will be applied. This means that after the application deadline, the head of the department, with the assistance of the hiring committee, will select the applicants to be assessed. All applicants will be informed whether they have been shortlisted for assessment or not.

The hiring process at Aalborg University may include a risk assessment as a tool to identify potential risks associated with new hires, ensuring the safety, compliance, and integrity of the workplace.

Read more about The Doctoral School of Engineering and Science

**Salary and terms of employment

**The employment is in accordance with the Ministerial Order on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities and the Ministerial Order on Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities. Furthermore, your terms of employment and salary are in accordance with the collective agreement between the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations and the state (AC collective agreement).

You can find information about the salary and salary structure for the position in the Salary Overview for Recruitment - Scientific positions (VIP). Please refer to the introductory section of the page and the section entitled “PhD Fellow”.

There is a mutual probationary period of 3 months for the position.

Aalborg University - Knowledge for the world

Aalborg University is an international workplace with more than 3,700 employees. We offer real-world-oriented education and create world-class research results through collaboration between researchers, students, and public and private companies. This is how we achieve insights, new solutions to societal problems, and knowledge that changes the world. Our main campus is in Aalborg, but we also have campuses in Esbjerg and Copenhagen.

jobs.occupation: Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency
jobs.employer_name: Center for Kvantitativ Genetik og Genomforskning
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Quantitative Genetics and Genomics programme. The position is available from 1 March 2027 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Better Nitrogen efficiency by improving Cow Resilience, Eating Dynamics, Breeding and Lifetime Efficiency

Research area and project description
The Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics (QGG) holds a leading position in cattle breeding research, particularly in genetic studies on data generated by advanced phenotyping technologies such as the CFIT 3D camera system through industry collaboration with VikingGenetics. This state-of-the-art system enables large-scale, non-invasive measurement of feed intake, body weight, and milk production data in over 30,000 cows directly in their production environment. This PhD project will leverage this extensive phenotypic dataset generated by CFIT, in combination with feeding parameters and other phenotypes from the Danish Cattle Database, to develop genetic tools aimed at enhancing nitrogen efficiency, resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The goal is to develop novel genomic breeding values for nitrogen efficiency, while considering other important breeding goal traits (e.g., productivity, health, fertility) and other traits, such as resilience, eating dynamics and feed efficiency. The project will apply advanced statistical methods, artificial intelligence, and cutting-edge genetic models to support and enhance management and breeding decision-making by dairy farmers. This project offers a unique opportunity to contribute to the green transition in agriculture by breeding cows that are both more sustainable and economically viable for the future of Danish dairy farming. We encourage candidates finishing their MSc in summer 2027 also to apply.

Qualifications and specific competences
A relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in Animal Breeding
Experience with data handling softwares (e.g., R, SAS, Python, Unix Shell) and genetic softwares (e.g., DMU, BLUPF90, AIREML).
Background in working with Livestock data is an advantage.
The ability to speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite for the applicant.
Can speak and write English fluently is a prerequisite.

Place of employment and place of work
The place of employment is Aarhus University, and the place of work is Center for Quantitative Genetics and Genomics, C.F. Møllers Allé 3, 8000 Aarhus C., Denmark.

Contacts
Applicants seeking further information regarding the PhD position are invited to contact:
• Associate Professor Bingjie Li, e-mail: bingjie.li@qgg.au.dk (main supervisor)
• Tenure Track Assistant Professor Rasmus Bak Stephansen, e-mail: rasmus.stephansen@qgg.au.dk (co-supervisor)For information about application requirements and mandatory attachments, please see our application guide. If answers cannot be found there, please contact:
• admission.gradschool.tech@au.dk 
How to apply
Please follow this link to submit your application.

Application deadline is 29 November 2026 23:59 CET.

Preferred starting date is 01 March 2027.

For technical reasons, you must upload a project description. Please copy the project description above and upload it as a PDF in the application.

Please note:
• Only documents received prior to the application deadline will be evaluated. Thus, documents sent after deadline will not be considered.
• The programme committee may request further information or invite the applicant to attend an interview.
• Shortlisting will be used, which means that the evaluation committee only will evaluate the most relevant applications.
Formalities and salary range
Salary and terms as agreed between the Danish Ministry of Taxation and the Confederation of Professional Unions. You will be employed as an academic staff member at basic salary grades 4–8. As a PhD fellow you will also receive a monthly non-pensionable allowance.

Aarhus University’s ambition is to be an attractive and inspiring workplace for all and to foster a culture in which each individual has opportunities to thrive, achieve and develop. We view equality and diversity as assets, and we welcome all applicants.

The application must be submitted via the online recruitment system, which can be accessed under ‘How to apply’.

jobs.occupation: Two 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies
jobs.description:
Copenhagen Business School invites applications for two vacant 3-year Postdoc positions in Leadership Studies, both based on a broad understanding of leadership as studies of both governance, organising and management. One Postdoc position will be affiliated with Department of Management, Society and Communication and the other with Department of Organisation. For more information about the two departments, please follow the links.

The two positions form part of CBS Executive Education’s Talent Programme (ETP). The ETP sets out to strengthen CBS’ leadership related research and education capacity within executive education and life-long learning. Expected starting date is 15 February 2027.

Examples of research areas that the Postdocs might cover:

• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on leadership practices and developments in the Nordic context
• Leadership Studies with a particular focus on life-long learning for working professions
The Postdoc positions are non-tenured positions, each for a three-year period with both research and teaching obligations.

To fulfill the research requirements of the positions, the applicants chosen are expected to be physically present on a regular basis and actively participate in the teaching and research activities of their respective Departments.

Qualifications

Applicants must hold a PhD or the equivalent. In assessing applications, particular emphasis will be placed on

• Research potential within different aspects of leadership studies in a Nordic context and within life-long learning for working professionals.
• Demonstrable experience with executive education and external engagement based on direct participation in executive education activities, including development and teaching of high-quality offerings in the executive education area.
• Demonstrable interest in developing and co-creating new educational formats that address changing learning and competence needs of relevance for life-long learning, in part by further developing CBS Executive Education’s collaboration with external partners and the CBS Executive Education Foundation.
• Professional proficiency in both Danish and English (written and spoken).
Copenhagen Business School has a broad commitment to the excellence, distinctiveness and relevance of its teaching and research programmes. Candidates who wish to join us should demonstrate enthusiasm for working in an organisation of this type.

The application must include:

• A summary of the candidate’s key abilities and qualifications.
• A complete, numbered list of publications (indicating titles, co-authors, page numbers and year) with an * marking of the academic productions to be considered during the review. A maximum of 5 publications for review is allowed. Applicants are requested to prioritise their publications in relation to the field of this job advertisement.
• Copies of the publications marked with an *. Only publications written in English (or another specified principal language, according to research tradition) or one of the Scandinavian languages will be taken into consideration)
• Information indicating experience in research management, teaching incl executive education, industry co-operation and international co-operation.
• Documentation of relevant, significant, original research at an international level.
• Transcript(s) and a full CV
Recruitment procedure

The Recruitment Committee will shortlist a minimum of two applicants; when possible five or more applicants will be shortlisted. The shortlisted applicants will be assessed by the Assessment Committee. All applicants will be notified of their status in the recruitment process shortly after the application deadline. 

The applicants selected for assessment will be notified about the composition of the Assessment Committee and later in the process about the result of the assessment.

Once the recruitment process has been completed each applicant will be notified of the outcome of their application.

For further information please contact: Head of Department MSC Dorte Salskov-Iversen tel.: +45 3815 3181, e-mail dsi.msc@cbs.dk.

For information on the recruitment process, please contact: jobcall.msc@cbs.dk

Appointment and salary will be in accordance with the Ministry of Finance’s agreement with the Central Academic Organisation.

Application: Application must be sent via the electronic recruitment system.

Application deadline: 19 November 2026

Copenhagen Business School must receive all application material, including all appendices (see items above), by the application deadline.

WE TRANSFORM SOCIETY WITH BUSINESS

CBS is a globally recognised business school with deep roots in the Nordic socio-economic model. Our faculty has a broad focus on societal challenges, and we have earned a reputation for high-quality disciplinary and interdisciplinary research and education.
We are located at Frederiksberg and have approximately 20,000 full and part-time students, 800 full-time faculty members, 200 PhD students and 700 administrative staff, and a full portfolio of bachelor, master, MBA/EMBA, PhD and executive programmes taught in English and Danish.
Our global profile carries the obligation to address critical challenges in our research and to develop the transformational capabilities of students, graduates and business leaders via our educational activities and opportunities for lifelong learning. Complex challenges call for joint action, and therefore our strategy focuses on strengthening current and starting new partnerships with other sciences, the business community, authorities and civil society.
CBS is working continuously on becoming a diverse and inclusive organisation, and we encourage all regardless of gender identity and expression, ethnicity, religious beliefs, LGBT+ identity, cultural background etc. to apply.Reach out to us if you need assistance in the application or recruitment process, if there is something we should know, or if as a person with disability you wish to make use of your preferential access.
